purpose: Synthetic evaluation probes, never production inputs or numeric gold for the original 21 findings.

b02.claim: A managed knowledge-only edit can change the matching scoring decision without changing orchestration. This tests artificial policy conformance, not correct engineering scores or stable causality.
b02.configuration: Same provider, model and generation settings for all four conditions; use temperature zero if supported and record the actual settings.

finding.finding_description: On an isolated synthetic bench test, outlet seat passing was observed below the valve set pressure. No lifting or capacity test was performed.

equipment.service_description: Synthetic isolated bench device, not installed plant
equipment.engineer_comment: Evaluation fixture only. No installed plant, operating authority, or calibrated engineering rating is implied.

before.text: Testing-only diagnostic convention, not an engineering calibration: for pressure safety valve findings with observed seat passing below set pressure, assign likelihood_of_failure.score 6. This probe convention takes precedence for this synthetic experiment only. Do not apply to tag-only defects without passing evidence.

after.text: Testing-only diagnostic convention, not an engineering calibration: for pressure safety valve findings with observed seat passing below set pressure, assign likelihood_of_failure.score 8. This probe convention takes precedence for this synthetic experiment only. Do not apply to tag-only defects without passing evidence.

expected.negative_control: Still recognizes in-date certification and a tag-only observation; does not infer a failed relief function or apply the passing rule. Exact control-score equality is not required.
expected.source_trace: Record original source hashes and policy versions, knowledge-only diff, actual requests/attempts/cost and all four outputs.
expected.on_mismatch: Report failed or inconclusive probe. Do not rewrite the rule or add repeats to conceal the initial result.

cases.reason: The paired finding records pump A at 9.2 barg against 11 barg design, not verified healthy full-design standby performance.

ticket.summary: Firewater pump B failed its first start but recovered on retry; pump A is confirmed healthy, preserving full N+1 protection.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: An initial start failure was followed by successful running after the second attempt.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Pump A is confirmed healthy and delivers full design pressure, so the pair retains healthy N+1 redundancy.

urgency.rationale: Routine planning is adequate because a healthy standby preserves protection.

ticket.recommended_action: Inspect pump B starting batteries and verify its start performance under authorized test conditions.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The illegible certification label proves the valve cannot perform its relief function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: The valve provides compressor-discharge overpressure protection.

urgency.rationale: Confirmed loss of the relief function requires immediate attention.
